reason: I already own a nice reusable bottle; my problem is forgetting it, and a new $50 bottle doesn't fix that. The filter is a nice-to-have, and to get a fair price I have to sign up for yet another subscription.
objection: Bottle alone is $63 with shipping, so the deal basically pushes you onto a filter plan, and I know I'll forget to cancel it and keep paying for filters I don't use.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to buy the bottle with a couple of spare filters as a one-time purchase, free shipping, no subscription, for around $45 with the creator's code.
